description: This file defines an abstract unit test class for the SuiteCRM Search component within the SuiteCRM project. It provides utility methods for invoking protected/private methods and setting private property values via reflection, intended for use in unit testing of search-related classes.

classes.name: SearchTestAbstract
classes.description: An abstract unit test class providing utility methods for invoking non-public methods and setting private properties during unit testing of search-related classes in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: invokeMethod
methods.description: Calls a protected/private method of a given object using reflection, allowing it to be tested or accessed.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a private property of an object via reflection, useful for setting internal state during testing.
